41:2.text: a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -

41:3.text: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān

41:4.text: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.

41:5.text: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings
from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work;

41:6.text: , "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allāh

41:7.text: Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

41:8.text: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.

41:9.text: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

41:10.text: firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its
sustenance in four days without distinction

41:11.text: to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come
willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."
